## Why This Is Asked
This tests practical knowledge of cross-region data purge with Aurora Global Database, RLS, and DR.

## Key Concepts
- Row-level security per tenant
- Soft delete strategy vs hard delete
- Cross-region replication lag and purge timing

```javascript
// Example purge task (conceptual)

}
```

- How would you monitor purge latency across regions?
- How would you handle tenant reactivation after purge?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests tenant isolation, cross-region cache invalidation, and DR readiness in AWS DB stacks.

```javascript
function purgeTenantCache(redis, tenantId){
  const prefix=`tenant:${tenantId}:`;

  }
}
```
